explication: Passivbot is a cryptocurrency perpetual-futures trading system. A user invokes the CLI with configuration; configuration is loaded and compiled, market data and account state are gathered from exchange adapters, and the shared Rust orchestrator computes entries, re-entries, trailing/grid closes, risk actions, and protective orders. Live execution submits and reconciles orders, while the same orchestration supports backtests and evolutionary optimization. OHLCV, fills, events, and monitoring provide durable analysis. Some live wiring is inferred from documented capabilities and directory structure because sampled excerpts are partial.
